description_zh: 重型卡车（ego）在故障交通灯前，进入对向车道试图超越静止的 Waymo 自动驾驶车辆（v2），在超越过程中卡车右侧与 Waymo 左后角发生侧面擦碰。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was stopped facing a malfunctioning traffic light on southbound Alabama Street at the intersection with Cesar Chavez Street.
a heavy truck that had been stopped behind the Waymo AV entered the oncoming lane of Alabama Street to maneuver around the Waymo AV.
As the heavy truck was passing the stopped Waymo AV, the passenger side of the heavy truck made contact with the rear driver side corner of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 重型卡车作为移动并执行超车决策的车辆，选为 ego；Waymo AV 静止于相邻车道，作为 NPC。碰撞为双方交互，现有词汇表可表达，行为块 static_hold 与 position adjacent 准确描述 NPC 静止位置，ego 的 overtake_oncoming 机动反映其进入对向车道超越的行为。
